kind: Host-only strict isolated report probe correction; not included in actual Android8d source
reportEnvelopeDependency: The new strict predecessor package field is emitted by the separately validated terminal-report patch; see host-native-terminal-report-20261003.json.
implemented: One read-only adb shell -T run-as request emits an exact package/path ABSENT or EXISTS sentinel; file/directory/symlink/permission/unknown stdout/stderr/ADB failures are rejected.
Fresh files directory absence is valid. Existing reports decode as one strict UTF8 JSON object without duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity or exponent overflow.

Reopen requires the actual retained passed predecessor with strict package/build/phase/runId/schema types/nonce/owner/common business flags and complete schema3 flags; failed, unfinished, malformed or unrelated input never receives another nonce.
Probe stdout/stderr/metadata including timeout partial output are retained before evaluation. A timeout/read failure does not replay the one nonce publication or am start.
The existing four real launch phases and their nonce/previous chain are unchanged; OS Settings Back does not invoke prepare_launch.
newHostRegressions: Actual exec-out-shaped code0+cat error text is rejected as unknown, and its exact bytes are preserved by the probe wrapper.

Exact ABSENT/EXISTS, wrong identity/path/status, unknown stdout/stderr, host failure, duplicate/nested JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, bad schema/types/terminal errors and missing predecessor are covered.

Portable Git sh actually exercises temporary filesystem absent files/empty directory/bad files type/report directory/existing JSON. Linux additionally exercises symlink cases; that conditional branch was not executed on Windows.
Three legal reopen predecessor transitions and initial absence still publish a nonce exactly once. Failed original input and timeout partial bytes are preserved without publication/retry.
boundaries: These are host protocol and temporary filesystem checks, not a new AVD execution.
The original source8d cat stdout/stderr is unavailable; the fix addresses a proven general protocol flaw without fabricating its exact historical input.
The Windows portable sh path was added only to that test child process environment; no global SDK, system environment, security or ACL configuration was changed.
